projects.title: Field Audit Assistant
projects.desc: Auditors photograph and narrate issues on the spot. The system drafts a traceable corrective-action record, and the fix closes within seven days.
projects.problem: Audit findings were written up by hand after each walk, details got lost along the way, and follow-up actions often slipped past their deadline.
projects.role: Defined the requirements, wrote the IT spec and built the working mobile prototype.

projects.title: Smart Audit Dispatch
projects.desc: Every morning, MES and SPC anomalies produce a ranked list of machines to audit and dispatch it to inspectors, so audits go where the problems are.
projects.problem: Inspectors audited machines on a fixed rotation, while machines already showing anomalies in MES and SPC were not prioritized.
projects.role: Proposed the concept and wrote the requirements for management and IT review.

projects.title: OIS 2.0 Inspection Platform
projects.desc: Led the inspection system's UI redesign and automated first-article inspection gating, rolled out across many production workstations.
projects.problem: Inspection navigation was hard to follow, and first-article results were passed along by hand without a link to the work order.
projects.role: Led the UI redesign and first-article inspection improvements, and coordinated the rollout across workstations.

projects.title: HR Notice Automation
projects.desc: Automatically anonymizes names, condenses notice text and screens leave-document photos, with HR review kept for borderline cases.
projects.problem: Each monthly notice meant manually masking names, trimming text and checking leave documents one by one.
projects.role: Turned the HR requirements into the functional and program specs, including the review rules.

projects.title: CAM Back-office Automation
projects.desc: Engineering jobs flow from scheduling through scripted processing to database write-back without manual hand-offs.
projects.problem: Design staff repeated the same scheduling and scripting steps for every engineering job.
projects.role: Defined the automation flow, tracked delivery and reported progress to leadership.

projects.title: Material Error-proofing
projects.desc: Binds work order, material lot and reel ID to replace hand labeling, tracks reel usage automatically, with an RFID roadmap.
projects.problem: Labels went missing or were swapped, thickness readings were copied by hand, and reel life was never recorded.
projects.role: Defined the control rules and wrote the IT spec and data table definitions.

projects.title: SubVerse
projects.subtitle: Taiwan dive companion
projects.desc: An all-in-one app for divers in Taiwan: trip prep, sea conditions, a digital dive log, a certification wallet, and a 3D underwater world you can actually swim through.
features: "Can I dive today?" signal for each dive site
Dive-computer import, replayed as a 3D track
Marine-life collection unlocked by real dives
projects.problem: Divers in Taiwan check sea conditions, logs and certifications across scattered apps and websites.
projects.role: Solo: product, design, development and app-store release.

projects.title: Smart Sats
projects.subtitle: Bitcoin for beginners
projects.desc: A beginner's guide to Bitcoin dollar-cost averaging, led by Cong-Cong the squirrel. Practice with real historical prices before risking real money.
features: Pick your own indicators, check today's buy signal
Stash log, winter mode, stash-day reminders
projects.problem: Beginners want to start with Bitcoin but don't know how dollar-cost averaging plays out or when to buy.

projects.title: JiYu SkillMeet
projects.subtitle: Skill exchange for Taiwan
projects.desc: Teach someone photography, learn Excel in return. A PWA you add straight to your home screen.
features: Shipped with every test scenario passing
projects.problem: Paid courses are expensive, while many people have a skill they would happily teach in exchange.
projects.role: Solo: product, full-stack development and deployment.

projects.title: CAP Tutor
projects.subtitle: Junior-high exam practice
projects.desc: Practice for Taiwan's junior-high CAP exam across all five subjects, aligned to the current curriculum and organized by semester.
features: A step-by-step tutor for every wrong answer
Free for top-3 students in their school
projects.problem: Students practice past exam questions but get little explanation of what they got wrong.
projects.role: Solo: product definition, design and development.

profile.intro: I'm a smart-manufacturing project manager in Kaohsiung, building inspection, audit and automation systems with production and IT teams at a flexible-PCB maker. Outside work, I design and ship my own apps for divers, new investors and students.
